about: Six criteria sets for deck-criteria.js (Linear ROB-109), built by tests/deck-criteria.mjs over the committed stores (tests/helpers/catalog-rows.mjs) with Rob's owned counts as the library where `library` is true. Each must come back a legal hundred, within its cap and its bracket, with a reason on every slot; `expect` pins what the set is about.

sets.says: A given commander, the Aggressive playstyle, bracket 3, $150, owned first; the suite then fences out one card this build took and builds again
No commander: suggested for green and white, Value engine, bracket 2, $75, no library
Nothing but a playstyle and a bracket: Combo at bracket 4, no cap, no colors
Mono-blue, Reactive, bracket 1, $50: answers on a budget with no Game Changers
Five colors at bracket 5 with $400, two cards asked for and one fenced out, owned first
A given four-color commander, Combo, bracket 3, $200, owned copies not preferred
